description: This file defines the ClaimAttachment entity class for the OrangeHRM Claim plugin, including ORM mapping annotations, properties, and getter/setter methods for handling claim attachment data stored in the database.

classes.name: ClaimAttachment
classes.description: Entity class representing a claim attachment in the OrangeHRM Claim plugin, mapped to the 'ohrm_claim_attachment' database table with properties for attachment details and ORM annotations.

methods.name: getRequestId
methods.description: Returns the request ID associated with the attachment.

methods.name: setRequestId
methods.description: Sets the request ID associated with the attachment.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the attachment file.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the attachment file.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the attachment.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the attachment.

methods.name: getFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: setFilename
methods.description: Sets the filename of the attachment.

methods.name: getAttachment
methods.description: Returns the attachment data, possibly as a resource or string.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type of the attachment.

methods.name: setFileType
methods.description: Sets the MIME type of the attachment.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Returns the user who attached this file.

methods.name: setUser
methods.description: Sets the user who attached this file.

methods.name: getAttachedDate
methods.description: Returns the date and time when the attachment was added.

methods.name: setAttachedDate
methods.description: Sets the date and time when the attachment was added.
